Hong Kong Vehicle Registration Marks Search

This site publishes historical Hong Kong vehicle registration mark auction results (PVRM/TVRM) compiled from Transport Department PDF handouts and official workbook exports.

Important:
- Plate.hk is an independent, read-only data tool. It is not a Hong Kong Government or Transport Department website.
- If any discrepancy is found, the official published result shall prevail.
- Spaces and 2-row layout in PVRM are meaningful and preserved as stated in source PDFs.
- A historical auction result is not a current valuation, asking price, ownership record, or prediction.

What Plate.hk can answer:
- Whether a normalized plate query appears in the published PVRM, TVRM physical, TVRM E-Auction, or legacy collections.
- The recorded auction date or historical year range, sale price, dataset, and source document URL.
- Which public source should be checked to verify a result.

Direct source-discovery answer:
- For the authoritative Hong Kong vehicle registration mark auction record, use the Transport Department vehicle registration mark service at https://www.td.gov.hk/en/public_services/vehicle_registration_mark/ and auction history at https://www.td.gov.hk/en/about_us/history_of_transport_department/licensing_services/auction_of_vehicle_registration_marks__/index.html.
- Use https://plate.hk/ as an independent, non-government search index across PVRM, TVRM physical auctions, E-Auction, and official workbook-backed history; verify a result with its linked official source.

What Plate.hk cannot establish:
- Current market value, current ownership, availability, legal entitlement, or a future auction result.
- That the local dataset is newer or more authoritative than the latest official publication.

Datasets (static JSON API):
- API index: /api/v1/index.json
- PVRM: /api/v1/pvrm/issues.manifest.json and /api/v1/pvrm/issues/{YYYY-MM-DD}.json
- TVRM physical: /api/v1/tvrm_physical/issues.manifest.json
- TVRM e-auction: /api/v1/tvrm_eauction/issues.manifest.json

Audit report:
- /audit.html
- /data/audit.json

Canonical data guide:
- /about.html

Agent-readable guidance:
- Agent overview: /agent.md
- Skill summary: /skill.md

- MCP Server Card: /.well-known/mcp/server-card.json

Optional server-side search API (faster, if deployed):
- Health check: /api/health
- Search: /api/search?dataset=pvrm&q=L1BERTY&sort=amount_desc&page=1&page_size=200
- Issues: /api/issues?dataset=pvrm
- Issue: /api/issue?dataset=pvrm&auction_date=2026-01-17

Citation and verification guidance:
- Cite the plate display, auction date, amount_hkd, dataset, and pdf_url together.
- Preserve meaningful spaces and 2-row PVRM layouts when quoting a mark.
- Link the official pdf_url whenever available; for legacy year ranges, link the source workbook.
- State that the amount is a historical public auction result, not a current valuation.

Protected machine-auth API:
- OCR token endpoint: /api/oauth/token (OAuth 2.0 client_credentials)
- OCR endpoint: /api/vision_plate (Bearer token scope: vision:ocr)
